claim: AB 1076 codified Edwards in § 16600(b)(1) and added § 16600.1, requiring employers to notify, by February 14, 2024, current employees and former employees employed after January 1, 2022 that their non-compete clauses are void.
evidence: The bill would require employers to notify current and former employees in writing by February 14, 2024, that the noncompete clause or agreement is void, as specified.
excerpt: AB 1076, Bauer-Kahan. Contracts in restraint of trade: noncompete agreements. Existing law voids contractual provisions by which a person is restrained from engaging in a lawful profession, trade, or business of any kind, except as otherwise provided. Existing case law, as established in the case of Edwards v. Arthur Andersen LLP (2008) 44 Cal.4th 937, interprets this provision to void noncompete agreements in an employment context and noncompete clauses within employment contracts, even if that agreement is narrowly tailored, unless an exception applies.
